title: Last Stone Weight
description: You are given an array of integers `stones` where `stones[i]` is the weight of the `i`th stone. Smash the two heaviest stones `x` and `y` (x <= y): if x == y both destroyed, if x < y, weight becomes y - x. Return the weight of the last remaining stone, or 0.
input_format: First line contains integer `n`, followed by `n` stone weights.
hints: Simulate a max-heap by pushing negative values into a min-heap.
Pop the two heaviest stones on each turn.
Push the difference back if they are not identical.

reference_solution:
import sys, heapq
data = sys.stdin.read().split()
if data:
    n = int(data[0])
    stones = [-int(x) for x in data[1:1+n]]
    heapq.heapify(stones)
    while len(stones) > 1:
        s1 = -heapq.heappop(stones)
        s2 = -heapq.heappop(stones)
        if s1 != s2: heapq.heappush(stones, -(s1 - s2))
    print(-stones[0] if stones else 0)
